s1.syndrome_frame: Exertional dyspnea and syncope with underlying cardiovascular and neurological conditions
key_facts: Dyspnea on exertion for the past year
Syncope during a bicycle ride with loss of consciousness
Elevated blood pressure of 150/78 mm Hg
Normal breath and heart sounds without murmurs
Normal hemogram, serum electrolytes, and thyroid function test

raw.syndrome_frame: Exertional dyspnea and syncope with underlying cardiovascular and neurological conditions
key_facts: Dyspnea on exertion for the past year
Syncope during a bicycle ride with loss of consciousness
Elevated blood pressure of 150/78 mm Hg
Normal breath and heart sounds without murmurs
Normal hemogram, serum electrolytes, and thyroid function test

shortlist.label: pulmonary hypertension
shortlist.why_kept: patient has mean pulmonary arterial pressure of 32 mm Hg

shortlist.label: hypertrophic cardiomyopathy
shortlist.why_kept: patient experiences dyspnea on exertion and syncope, which are common symptoms of this condition

shortlist.label: heart failure
shortlist.why_kept: patient has left atrial enlargement and uncertain diastolic function, which are indicative of heart failure

shortlist.label: av block
shortlist.why_kept: patient has first-degree and third-degree AV block, which can cause syncope and dyspnea on exertion

shortlist.label: cardiomyopathy
shortlist.why_kept: patient has uncertain diastolic function and left atrial enlargement, which are consistent with cardiomyopathy

raw.rationale: The patient's ECG and 24-hour ECG monitoring show first-degree and third-degree AV block, which can cause syncope and exercise intolerance due to impaired heart rate regulation.

rejected.label: pulmonary hypertension
rejected.why: Although present, it does not directly explain syncope and exercise intolerance as well as AV block does.

rejected.label: hypertrophic cardiomyopathy
rejected.why: There is no evidence of abnormal left ventricular wall thickness or outflow tract obstruction.

rejected.label: heart failure
rejected.why: Normal left ventricular ejection fraction and no signs of fluid overload make this less likely.

rejected.label: cardiomyopathy
rejected.why: The echocardiogram does not show significant valvular or wall motion abnormalities typical of cardiomyopathy.
